arxiv-2407-10455.title: On collectively L-weakly compact sets of operators
arxiv-2407-10455.creator: Eduard Emelyanov 1 . 1. Sobolev Institute of Mathematics, Novosibirsk, 630090, Russia
arxiv-2407-10455.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Eduard Emelyanov 1 . 1. Sobolev Institute of Mathematics, Novosibirsk, 630090, Russia. A set of bounded linear operators from a Banach space to a Banach lattice is collectively L-weakly compact whenever union of images of the unit ball is L-weakly compact. We extend the Meyer-Nieberg duality theorem to collectively L-weakly compact sets of operators, study relations between these sets and collectively almost limited sets, and discuss the domination problem for collectively compact sets and collectively L-weakly compact sets.

arxiv-2501-16245.title: SP-IMPact: A Framework for Static Partitioning Interference Mitigation and Performance Analysis
arxiv-2501-16245.creator: Diogo Costa, Gonçalo Moreira, Afonso Oliveira, José Martins, Sandro Pinto
arxiv-2501-16245.description: Abstract Modern embedded systems are evolving toward complex, heterogeneous architectures to accommodate increasingly demanding applications. Driven by industry SWAP-C (Size, Weight, Power, and Cost) constraints, this shift has led to the consolidation of multiple systems onto single hardware platforms. Static Partitioning Hypervisors (SPHs) offer a promising solution to partition hardware resources and provide spatial isolation between critical workloads.

arxiv-2505-21070.title: Minute-Long Videos with Dual Parallelisms
arxiv-2505-21070.creator: https://dualparal-project.github.io/dualparal.github.io/, Zeqing Wang, Bowen Zheng, Xingyi Yang, Zhenxiong Tan, Yuecong Xu, Xinchao Wang
arxiv-2505-21070.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by https://dualparal-project.github.io/dualparal.github.io/, Zeqing Wang, Bowen Zheng, Xingyi Yang, Zhenxiong Tan, Yuecong Xu, Xinchao Wang. Diffusion Transformer (DiT)-based video diffusion models generate high-quality videos at scale but incur prohibitive processing latency and memory costs for long videos. To address this, we propose a novel distributed inference strategy, termed DualParal . The core idea is that, instead of generating an entire video on a single GPU, we parallelize both temporal frames and model layers across GPUs.

pmc-11654200.title: The spanish and catalan versions of the kidney patient reported experience measure (PREM) for chronic kidney disease (CKD): cultural adaptation and face validity
pmc-11654200.creator: M Moharra, A Llupià, B Bayés, C Almazán, A Busby, M Herdman
pmc-11654200.description: BackgroundChronic kidney disease (CKD) is a progressive condition affecting more than 800 million individuals worldwide. Patient Reported Experience Measures (PREMs) are questionnaires aimed at evaluating patients’ experiences with healthcare received. Given that CKD management often involves continuous treatments, capturing patient experiences can guide improvements in care that align with patients’ preferences, making PREMS a relevant tool in CKD management.

pmc-11714139.title: Data‐driven analysis of 10,361 amyloid‐PET scans from the IDEAS study reveals two primary axes of variation
pmc-11714139.creator: Joseph Giorgio, Nidhi S Mundada, Ganna Blazhenets, Jhony Alejandro Mejía‐Perez, Daniel R Schonhaut, Maria C Carrillo, Lucy Hanna, Constantine Gatsonis, Andrew March, Charles Apgar, Barry A Siegel, Bruce E Hillner, Rachel A Whitmer, William J Jagust, Gil D Rabinovici, Renaud La Joie
pmc-11714139.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe variability in the regional distribution of Aß‐PET signal and its relation to clinical features is debated. We used data‐driven approaches to uncover heterogeneity in cortical Aß‐PET signal from a large representative sample collected through the IDEAS study.MethodsWe analysed cross‐sectional Aß‐PET collected from 10,361 patients with MCI or mild dementia scanned in 295 PET facilities using one of the 3 FDA‐approved tracers. Central image processing resulted in template‐space SUVR images (reference: whole cerebellum) and centiloid (CL) values.

pmc-12734952.title: Decoding the Gut Microbiome in Primary Sjögren’s Syndrome and Primary Biliary Cholangitis: Shared Dysbiosis, Distinct Patterns, and Associations with Clinical Features
pmc-12734952.creator: Bo Zang, Lishan Xu, Haojie Huang, Qixuan Liu, Yuan Yao, Jiaxiu Li, Yifei Yang, Chenyang Zhao, Bingqian Liu, Bin Liu, Michael Doulberis
pmc-12734952.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). This study aimed to analyze gut microbiome similarities and differences between primary biliary cholangitis (PBC) and primary Sjögren’s syndrome (pSS), exploring potential associations with disease pathogenesis. High-throughput sequencing of the 16S rRNA gene was performed on fecal samples from 100 subjects (PBC: 38; pSS: 42; HC: 20) to compare the composition, diversity, and key microbial markers, examining associations with clinical indicators.

pmc-12937568.title: A novel superficial temporal artery patency concept of cerebral revascularization for patients with moyamoya disease: a multicenter study

pmc-13416109.title: A hybrid deep learning and cellular automata framework with fractional derivatives for skin type and skin disease classification
pmc-13416109.creator: M. V. N. S. S. Kiranmai, C. Thanmayee Reddy, Gaddam Nikitha, Pattabiraman Venkattasubbu, Parvathi Ramasubramanian
pmc-13416109.description: IntroductionA hybrid deep learning and mathematical modeling approach to automatic identification of skin type and multi-class classification of skin diseases based on dermatological images are proposed in this paper. A coherent mechanism to combine deep features learning and texture modeling approaches mathematically is a necessity for improved skin type classification and skin diseases categorizations.

pmc-13604531.title: Periodontal Dysbiosis and Premature Atherosclerosis: A Critical Appraisal of the Oral–Gut–Vascular Axis
pmc-13604531.creator: Larisa Anghel, Dan-Nicolae Bele, Radu Andy Sascău, Laura-Cătălina Benchea, Monica Mihaela Scutariu, Cristina Prisacariu, Rodica Radu, Mircea Ovanez Balasanian, Cristian Stătescu
pmc-13604531.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Premature coronary artery disease (PCAD) is not fully explained by conventional risk factors, particularly in younger adults with residual inflammatory risk. This review evaluates the oral–gut–vascular axis as a mechanistic framework linking periodontal dysbiosis to premature atherosclerosis. Methods: A structured narrative search of PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, Embase, and Web of Science was conducted for English-language publications issued between January 2015 and June 2026.

pmc-13605547.title: Invasive Neonatal Enterovirus Infection: A Case Series and Review of the Literature
pmc-13605547.creator: Nicoletta Menzella, Simonetta Costa, Simona Fattore, Davide De Tomaso, Francesca Paola Fusco, Linda Sessa, Chiara Tirone, Francesca Priolo, Angela Paladini, Francesca Serrao, Tommaso Verdolotti, Rosaria Santangelo, Giovanni Vento
pmc-13605547.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights What are the main findings? •Nine neonates with invasive enterovirus infection presented predominantly with meningitis; one developed concurrent myocarditis. All infants received IVIG and had favorable outcomes at discharge.•Symptom onset ranged from the second to the thirty-fourth day of life; eight of nine infants developed symptoms after 72 h, a pattern compatible with either intrapartum-acquired infection (given the typical enteroviral incubation period) or postnatal acquisition, which this case series cannot distinguish with certainty. What are the implications of the main findings?
